profiles.description: Runs the technical accounting for ABC Insurance's assumed and ceded reinsurance from Reinsurance Operations. Owns reconciling inward bordereaux totals to cedant summary statements and posting validated bordereaux data to the reinsurance ledger; calculating assumed premium and ceding commission per treaty terms; applying earned/unearned premium recognition splits; posting premium and commission journal entries to the general ledger; and resolving premium booking exceptions with corrected entries. Also reconciles ceded premium against treaty proportions and booked premium back to bordereaux and cedant accounts current. On the assumed side, owns receiving and registering cedant loss advices against treaties, verifying completeness and contractual coverage applicability, assessing losses against retention limits and excess attachment points, and chasing missing documentation from cedants.
